y-m-48-01.s.s1.line.2: Ukuchasana kokuphika kuka-p: Ukuba x≤2, ngoko x²≤4.

y-m-48-01.s.s1.explain: Umgca 3 yindawo apho ingxaki iqala khona. 'Ukuba x≤2, ngoko x²≤4' sisiphakamiso (ukuphika) esenziwe ngokuphika kuphela ingqikelelo nesigqibo ngasinye, ngelixa ukuchasana kokuphika kwenza ukuphika kwesigqibo kube yingqikelelo nokuphika kwengqikelelo kube sisigqibo: 'Ukuba x²≤4, ngoko x≤2'. Yiyo le nto isigqibo komgca 5 singachanekanga nasi. Umgca 1 sele ubonise ukuba p inyanisile, kwaye ukuchasana kokuphika okuchanekileyo 'Ukuba x²≤4, ngoko x≤2' kunyanisile. Ibalo lomgca 4 (x=−3) lichanekile kwisiphakamiso esakhiwe gwenxa.

y-m-48-01.s.s3.prompt: Isiphakamiso esitsha q: "Ukuba x sisiphindaphindi se-6, ngoko x sisiphindaphindi se-3" (x linani eliphelele) sinyanisile. Phakathi kokuchasana, ukuphika, nokuchasana kokuphika kuka-q, kwesiphi onokuthi kwangoko kunyanisile ngenyaniso ka-q kuphela?
y-m-48-01.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala u-q, ukuchasana, ukuphika, nokuchasana kokuphika kumabhokisi "ingqikelelo → isigqibo," uze uphawule ukuba lithini kuzo elitshintsha amabhokisi ka-q nokuba litshintsha njani.
y-m-48-01.s.s3.hint.1: Kwezo uthandabuza ukuba zinyanisile, faka amaxabiso afana no-3, 6, 9 uze uvavanye ukuba akuvelanga mzekelo ochasayo.
y-m-48-01.s.s3.o.a: Inverse ye-q: Ukuba x ayiliphindo le-6, ngoko x ayiliphindo le-3
y-m-48-01.s.s3.r.a: x=3 ngumzekelo ochasayo. U-3 ayiliphindo le-6, kodwa liliphindo le-3. Oku akuxhomekekanga kwinyaniso yesindululo sokuqala.
y-m-48-01.s.s3.o.b: Contrapositive ye-q: Ukuba x ayiliphindo le-3, ngoko x ayiliphindo le-6
y-m-48-01.s.s3.o.c: Converse ye-q: Ukuba x liliphindo le-3, ngoko x liliphindo le-6
y-m-48-01.s.s3.r.c: x=3 ngumzekelo ochasayo. U-3 liliphindo le-3 kodwa asiliphindo le-6. Nokuba isindululo sokuqala sinyani, inyaniso ye-converse kufuneka ihlolwe ngokwahlukileyo.
y-m-48-01.s.s3.o.d: Kwi-converse, i-inverse, ne-contrapositive, akukho namnye onokuthiwa unyani ngo-q kuphela
y-m-48-01.s.s3.r.d: I-contrapositive ihlala inexabiso lenyaniso elifanayo nesindululo sokuqala. Qala uhlele ukuba yeyiphi i-contrapositive.
y-m-48-01.s.s3.explain: I-contrapositive ihlala inexabiso lenyaniso elifanayo nesindululo sokuqala, ngoko ukuba q inyani, i-contrapositive "Ukuba x ayiliphindo le-3, ngoko x ayiliphindo le-6" nayo inyani. I-converse ne-inverse kufuneka zihlolwe ngokwahlukileyo ku-q, yaye kule meko x=3 ngumzekelo ochasayo, ngoko zombini azinyani.

y-m-48-03.title: Fumana ixabiso luka-a eliyenza imeko eyanelisayo
y-m-48-03.topic: Ukubandakanywa kweeseti zenyaniso noluhlu lonobumba a
y-m-48-03.goal: Jika imeko eyanelisayo ibe kukubandakanywa kweeseti zenyaniso, yenza amaxabiso amaninzi anokwenzeka onobumba a, uze ucacise indlela ukubandakanya okanye ukungabandakanyi iziphelo kuchaphazela ngayo uluhlu.
y-m-48-03.material: Kukho iimeko ezimbini malunga nenani leqinisileyo x. p: −1≤x≤2, q: |x−a|≤3 (a linani leqinisileyo). Sifuna ukukhetha a ukuze 'ukuba p ngoko q' ibe nyani. (|x−a| ifundwa ngokuthi 'ixabiso eliphelele lika-x ukususa a'. |x−a|≤3 kuthetha ukuba x ikumgama ongu-3 ubuninzi ukusuka ku-a.)

y-m-48-03.s.s1.prompt: Xa 'ukuba p ngoko q' inyani, oko kuthetha ntoni ngo-P no-Q, amaqela ama-x (iiseti zenyaniso) anelisa p no-q?
y-m-48-03.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala ngamazwi ukuba x yayiya kufuneka ibe yintoni ukuze 'ukuba p ngoko q' ingabi nyani.
y-m-48-03.s.s1.hint.1: Vavanya isivakalisi ngamaqela amancinci anje nge-P={1, 2}, Q={1, 2, 3} ukubona ukuba ihambelana na.
y-m-48-03.s.s1.r.a: Icala lijikile. 'Ukuba p ngoko q' kuthetha ukuba ukuba p iyaneliseka, q iyaneliseka nayo.
y-m-48-03.s.s1.o.b: Kukho ubuncinane u-x o-1 okwi-P nakwi-Q zombini
y-m-48-03.s.s1.r.b: Ukugqithelana kwindawo enye ubuncinane kwahlukile ekubeni wonke u-x we-P ungaphakathi kwe-Q. Ukuba kukho u-x kwi-P ongekho kwi-Q, ngumzekelo ochasayo.
y-m-48-03.s.s1.r.d: Ukuba nenani elifanayo akwenzi amaqela alingane okanye elinye lifakwe ngaphakathi kwelinye.
y-m-48-03.s.s1.explain: 'Ukuba p ngoko q' ukuba nyani kuthetha ukuba wonke u-x owanelisa p wanelisa q nayo, ngoko P⊂Q.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.prompt: Faka amanani aqinisileyo a ahlukeneyo ama-4 enza p: −1≤x≤2 ibe yimeko eyanelisayo ku-q: |x−a|≤3. Akufuneki abe ngamanani aphelele.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala kwakhona |x−a|≤3 njengoluhlu (isithuba) lwe-x, uze uluzobe kumgca wamanani kunye no-P.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha ixabiso luka-a uze uhlole ukuba iziphelo zombini −1 no-2 ze-P zingaphakathi koluhlu lwe-q.

y-m-48-03.s.s2.explain: q yi-a−3≤x≤a+3. Ukuze P={x | −1≤x≤2} ifakwe lonke ngaphakathi kwe-Q, sidinga a−3≤−1 kunye 2≤a+3, ngoko −1≤a≤2. Lonke ixabiso koluhlu olu yimpendulo elungileyo.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Ukuba a=3, ngoko p asiyo imeko eyanelisayo ku-q. Cacisa kutheni ngokunika ixabiso elinye lokwenyani lika-x kwi-P.

y-m-48-03.s.s3.r.a: Uyithethe ngendlela efanayo nemeko ebandakanya iziphelo. Ukuba a=2, ngoko q yi-−1<x<5, ngoko hlola ukuba x=−1 kwi-P ibalulwe kuyo na.

y-m-48-05.title: Bangaphi abafundi abangajoyinanga nayiphi na iklabhu?
